preconditions: Center the camera and require two visible party members; temporary ranged and melee equipment, no save writes.
For each launcher test one shot with a stronger melee fixture in slot 45 and a weaker later candidate in slot 47.

After the ordinary UI click, transiently set the attacker's EA classification to ALLY before the last shot to exercise IsPC=false; require slot 45/set 1. Restore classification immediately after depletion.
Repeat with unchanged PC classification and require fists, despite available melee equipment. Restore equipment after each case.
This isolates the non-PC depletion branch on a party actor; it is not a full NPC AI scenario or original/reconstruction comparison.
